title: In a short exact sequence, a bound n on the middle term and n+1 on the quotient bound the submodule by n
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $m\ge0$ an integer and $0\to M'\xrightarrow{u}M\xrightarrow{v}M''\to0$ a short exact sequence of $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] ($u$ injective, $v$ surjective, $\operatorname{Im}u=\operatorname{Ker}v$). Assume that $M$ has a projective resolution of length $\le m$ and that $M''$ has a projective resolution of length $\le m+1$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension] (exact sequences $0\to P_m\to\dots\to P_0\to M\to0$ and $0\to Q_{m+1}\to\dots\to Q_0\to M''\to0$ with all $P_i$, $Q_i$ projective $R$-modules). Then $M'$ has a projective resolution of length $\le m$.
